content.title: Energy investor Five Point targets $2 billion from Northwind pipelines sale, sources say
content.summary: (Reuters) -The private equity owner of Northwind Midstream is exploring a potential sale of the Permian Basin gas infrastructure operator, with any deal expected to value the company upwards of $2 billion, including debt, people familiar with the matter said.  Five Point Infrastructure is working with investment bankers at Piper Sandler on the sale effort.  The process is in its early stages, with initial outreach made to potential buyers, and interest is expected to come from midstream companies as well as other buyout and infrastructure funds.
